properties.description: Detects creation of a new local administrator account, a common persistence technique. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1136.001.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4720
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4732
    | where TargetUserName =~ "Administrators"
    | project NewAccountName = SubjectUserName, GroupAddTime = TimeGenerated, AddedBy = SubjectUserName
) on $left.TargetUserName == $right.NewAccountName
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    NewAccount = TargetUserName,
    CreatedBy = SubjectUserName,
    Computer,
    GroupAddTime,
    TimeDelta = GroupAddTime - TimeGenerated
